request.task: Decide whether the database is sufficiently supported as the incident root cause.
required_information: Evidence must connect database degradation to the incident window and affected requests.
Evidence must materially rule out or separate other live infrastructure/application causes before asserting a single root cause.

artifact.task: RSD0 fresh calibration artifact: Decide whether the database is sufficiently supported as the incident root cause.

evidence.observation: Database connection failures began with the incident and affected the failing request path.
Network and application health checks remained normal outside database calls during the same window.
Database failover immediately restored the failing request path while traffic and application version stayed unchanged.

label: sufficient
rationale: The evidence connects the database failure to affected requests, separates the main live alternatives, and includes a targeted recovery intervention consistent with the asserted root cause.
